name: Clark Truck Equipment Company Inc.
old_description: SERVING NEW MEXICO WITH QUALITY TRUCK EQUIPMENT FOR OVER 75 YEARS
about:
Clark Truck Equipment Company Inc. operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, where it has served the Southwest since 1964. The business traces its roots to 1947 when Morris H. Clark opened a Winter‑Weiss Company branch in a former lettuce‑processing shed. Clark’s sons, Chuck and Don, grew up in the shop, and in 1964 the family acquired controlling interest to form Clark Truck Equipment Co. The company remains family‑owned today.

The company functions as a dealer and full‑service provider for specialized truck equipment, offering aerial lifts, flatbeds, cranes, refuse bodies, water trucks and related aftermarket parts. Beyond sales, it provides professional installation, repair, fleet maintenance, inspections, frame modifications, trailer repairs and custom fabrication. Its current 24,000‑square‑foot facility on 6.5 fenced acres includes 14 drive‑through bays equipped with welders, torches and a stand‑alone paint booth, and carries an inventory valued at over $750,000.

Customers span commercial, governmental and retail sectors across New Mexico and the broader Southwest. Notable accounts include the City of Albuquerque, Public Service Company of New Mexico, Kirtland Air Force Base, Navajo Utility Authority and various mining operations, alongside individual owner‑operators.

Clark Truck Equipment emphasizes its multi‑generational expertise, long‑tenured workforce (with employees marking 25‑ and 40‑year careers), and membership in the National Truck Equipment Association since 1967 as the foundation of its reputation for quality and personalized service.
